COMPLEMENTARY.headline: One person's surplus is the other's missing piece.
COMPLEMENTARY.body: Your elemental balance feeds each other's gaps. This isn't just chemistry — it's structural. You can build something durable here.

BALANCED.headline: Your elements settle into an easy rhythm.
BALANCED.body: Neither of you overwhelms the other. There's enough overlap to feel understood, and enough difference to keep growing.

MODERATE.headline: The elemental fit is workable — not automatic.
MODERATE.body: You don't naturally slot together, but you don't collide either. The relationship will be built, not received.

TENSION.headline: You share too much of the same element.
TENSION.body: Both running hot (or both cold) creates intensity without relief. You'll need someone to break the loop — routines, friends, or space.

DEFAULT.headline: Your elements are still learning each other.
DEFAULT.body: There's no obvious elemental signature here. Watch how you each recharge — that's the tell.

STEM_UNION.headline: Your day masters are traditionally a pair.
STEM_UNION.body: In classical saju, this stem combination is one of the closest. There's an intuitive 'we belong together' quality here.

STEM_CLASH.headline: Your day masters push against each other.
STEM_CLASH.body: This is friction with a point — you make each other sharper. But without rest, the edges will wear you down.

BRANCH_UNION.headline: Your day branches bind easily.
BRANCH_UNION.body: Same rhythm, same instinct for how to be close. The bond feels familiar fast, which is beautiful — and sometimes blinding.

BRANCH_CLASH.headline: Your day branches clash directly.
BRANCH_CLASH.body: You trigger each other — often before you notice. The work is in not taking every clash personally.

TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: You see each other as peers.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body: Equal footing is your default. You'll compete sometimes, but you don't need to be taken care of.

TEN_GOD_WEALTH.headline: One of you feels seen as valuable by the other.
TEN_GOD_WEALTH.body: There's an instinct to build something concrete together — resources, a home, a future. Watch for the 'provider / receiver' dynamic getting one-sided.

TEN_GOD_OFFICER.headline: Structure pulls one of you toward the other.
TEN_GOD_OFFICER.body: One person naturally wants to lead, protect, or formalize. The other feels held — or pushed. Both are useful if spoken.

TEN_GOD_OUTPUT.headline: One of you feels freed by the other.
TEN_GOD_OUTPUT.body: There's an easy generosity here — ideas, energy, laughter. Don't let the expressive one burn out without being fed back.

TEN_GOD_RESOURCE.headline: One of you feels sustained by the other.
TEN_GOD_RESOURCE.body: There's a tender, almost maternal/paternal quality. Careful not to let one become the teacher and the other the student forever.

MIXED.headline: Your day masters find each other in a quieter way.
MIXED.body: No dramatic union or clash — the draw is subtle, learned over time. Trust the accumulated evidence.

COMPLEMENTARY.headline: Your work and money styles fit.
COMPLEMENTARY.body: One builds the structure; the other brings the momentum. You'd make a solid team on a small project or a shared life.

MIRROR.headline: You approach life the same way.
MIRROR.body: It feels safe because it's familiar. But mirrored patterns don't grow — someone has to introduce something new.

TENSION.headline: Your instincts on work and money pull apart.
TENSION.body: You'll each want to run things your way. That's not a dealbreaker — it's a conversation that has to happen out loud.

NEUTRAL.headline: Your work and money styles are compatible, not aligned.
NEUTRAL.body: No natural synergy and no natural clash. You'll design the rhythm together.

DEFAULT.headline: Your working styles have their own shape.
DEFAULT.body: Notice how each of you handles a small decision — that's where the pattern lives.

SHARED_ATTRACTION.headline: You both carry magnetic draw.
SHARED_ATTRACTION.body: There's chemistry between you that other people notice. That's real. It's also not enough — build something underneath it.

SHARED_DEPTH.headline: You both live in a deep inner world.
SHARED_DEPTH.body: You can go where most couples don't. The risk is that you both retreat silently at the same time.

SHARED_WANDER.headline: You both have restless feet.
SHARED_WANDER.body: Movement is easy between you. Staying in one place — physically or emotionally — is the actual project.

SHARED_LEADERSHIP.headline: You both want to lead.
SHARED_LEADERSHIP.body: You'll collide if you don't divide the territory. Clear domains of authority change everything.

SHARED_RESONANCE.headline: You share a special trait.
SHARED_RESONANCE.body: There's an unspoken recognition here. Use it — the relationship holds more when it's built on what you both carry.

OPPOSITE_PULL.headline: Your special traits pull in different directions.
OPPOSITE_PULL.body: You'll each bring something the other lacks. That's a gift and a strain — decide which one you treat it as.

SINGLE_ANCHOR.headline: One of you carries a rare trait.
SINGLE_ANCHOR.body: The other is the witness — and often the anchor. Don't let the witness role become invisibility.

NEITHER.headline: Neither of you leans on the special-trait axis.
NEITHER.body: The relationship rests on other things — your choice, your effort, your time.

DEFAULT.headline: Your special traits are still meeting each other.
DEFAULT.body: Notice what each of you reaches for when no one is watching.

PEAK.headline: Rare structural fit.
PEAK.body: This combination is unusually aligned across all four axes. It doesn't guarantee anything — but it means the relationship can hold more than most.

FAVORABLE.headline: A combination that can grow.
FAVORABLE.body: Not effortless, but structurally supported. The friction you'll feel is productive friction, not destructive.

NEUTRAL.headline: A relationship you build, not receive.
NEUTRAL.body: The chart gives you a blank canvas. What you two make of it is entirely yours.

CAUTION.headline: A combination that asks a lot.
CAUTION.body: There's real friction here. It's not a reason to leave — it's a reason to be honest, early, and often.

CHALLENGING.headline: A combination that asks everything.
CHALLENGING.body: The structure is working against you. That doesn't decide the outcome — but it does mean you must both be willing, consciously, most days.

DISCLAIMER: Note: This compatibility reading blends astronomical calculation with modern relationship frameworks. It is a symbolic, school-dependent reading — not a verdict, not a prediction, and not a substitute for honest conversation. You remain the author of this relationship.
